decisions: REMOVE_SCURVY_WORDING and REMOVE_SCURVY_HEAL_ATOMS move to champion_cleanses.py, not to cleanse_declarations.py where the map put them. Remove Scurvy is a champion ability and only CHAMPION_CLEANSE_DECLARATIONS reads the two; leaving them with the item wordings closes a cycle, because resolve_cleanse_item and item_declaration in cleanse_declarations.py look up the champion tables.
champion_cleanses.py is a leaf: nothing in it reads CleanseActivation, so the direction is cleanse_declarations -> champion_cleanses only.
_EPS moves with the interval primitives. It is the epsilon the span algebra compares with and nothing else reads it, so the module owns its own tolerance.
The excluded-kind vocabulary, _control_entries, CleanseEligibility and CleanseDecision stay: CleanseEligibility is the decision the file is named for, and it reads every moved module.
